¿Cuál fue el total facturado en 2003, desglosado por moneda?

WITH vigentes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (serie, LPAD(TRIM(numfac), 10, '0'))
         serie, LPAD(TRIM(numfac), 10, '0') AS folio, cliente, rfc, fecha, total, ref1, status
  FROM faccab
  ORDER BY serie, LPAD(TRIM(numfac), 10, '0'), fcaptura DESC
) SELECT ref1, SUM(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(total), '$', ''), ',', '')::numeric) AS total FROM vigentes WHERE status = 'V' AND fecha BETWEEN '20030101' AND '20031231' GROUP BY ref1 ORDER BY ref1

WITH vigentes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (serie, LPAD(TRIM(numfac), 10, '0'))
         serie, LPAD(TRIM(numfac), 10, '0') AS folio, cliente, rfc, fecha, total, ref1, status

) SELECT d.renglon, d.producto, d.cantidad, REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(d.importe), '$', ''), ',', '')::numeric AS importe FROM facdet d JOIN vigentes f ON d.serie = f.serie AND LPAD(TRIM(d.numfac), 10, '0') = f.folio WHERE f.status = 'V' AND d.status = 'A' AND f.serie = 'A' AND f.folio = '0000002770' ORDER BY d.renglon

¿Qué agente tuvo más facturas vigentes en 2004?

WITH vigentes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (serie, LPAD(TRIM(numfac), 10, '0'))
         serie, LPAD(TRIM(numfac), 10, '0') AS folio, cliente, rfc, fecha, total, ref1, status
  FROM faccab
  ORDER BY serie, LPAD(TRIM(numfac), 10, '0'), fcaptura DESC
) SELECT ref1, COUNT(*) AS facturas FROM vigentes WHERE status = 'V' AND ref1 LIKE 'AG%' AND fecha BETWEEN '20040101' AND '20041231' GROUP BY ref1 ORDER BY facturas DESC

¿Cuántas facturas vigentes hubo en abril de 2004 y cuánto suman?

WITH vigentes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (serie, LPAD(TRIM(numfac), 10, '0'))
         serie, LPAD(TRIM(numfac), 10, '0') AS folio, cliente, rfc, fecha, total, ref1, status
  FROM faccab
  ORDER BY serie, LPAD(TRIM(numfac), 10, '0'), fcaptura DESC
) SELECT COUNT(*) AS facturas, SUM(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(total), '$', ''), ',', '')::numeric) AS total FROM vigentes WHERE status = 'V' AND fecha BETWEEN '20040401' AND '20040431'
